name: Elesh Norn

bio.text: When the Phyrexians split into five factions each led by a praetor, Elesh Norn's white faction subdued the others and she became the Mother of Machines.

citations.text: "Phyrexian", section "Lore". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Elesh Norn", section "Victorious". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: She laid waste to Urabrask's and Sheoldred's domains and emerged as the sole power above New Phyrexia.

citations.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: She welcomed Karn as Father, had him captured and dissected, and struck a bargain with Tezzeret for a darksteel body in exchange for Karn.

citations.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

bio.text: She planned the invasion of the Multiverse through Realmbreaker, and a planeswalker strike team that infiltrated New Phyrexia was scattered by her planar shield.

"New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Assault on New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: She had Ajani execute the rebelling Sheoldred, ordered Urabrask's execution, and sent her compleated planeswalkers and Atraxa to conquer other planes.

citations.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Multiversal conquest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Urabrask", section "Possible death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Elesh Norn", section "Multiversal conquest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Elspeth wounded her in a duel at the Invasion Tree, and then Jin-Gitaxias mutinied and turned his army on her.

citations.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Final Battle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Elesh Norn", section "Defeat and Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: As New Phyrexia was displaced by Zhalfir, Karn broke his pacifist vow and killed Norn, which silenced the Phyrexian hive mind and ended the invasion.

citations.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Defeat and Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Elesh Norn", section "Defeat and Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

status.text: Elesh Norn is dead, killed by Karn during the invasion, and her death left Phyrexians across the Multiverse inert.

"Elesh Norn", section "Defeat and Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The infected Karn retreats to the core and the Panopticon becomes his throne; Jin-Gitaxias's servants hijack it.
timeline.quote: the Panopticon was converted into his throne

citation.text: "Panopticon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn restores the Panopticon and Tezzeret uses the Darksteel Eye with Karn's head.
timeline.quote: After the rise of Elesh Norn , she restored the Panopticon to its full functionality.

citation.text: "Panopticon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Panopticon becomes a prison for Karn and the World Tree essence grows into the Seedcore and Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: converted into a prison for Karn

citation.text: "Panopticon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn seizes power over the red and black factions of New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn seizes power over the red and black factions of New Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As New Phyrexia phases out, oil across the Multiverse is cut off and rendered inert; Phyrexians stop or crumble and the compleated fall into slumber.
timeline.quote: As New Phyrexia phased out of existence , glistening oil all across the Multiverse was cut off from its source and rendered inert.

citation.text: "Glistening oil", section "The Infection of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Each color alignment gains a Praetor, factionalizing the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: each alignment gained a Praetor to oversee that color

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Factionalizing and the Castes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reports to Bolas that the New Phyrexians had not yet attained interplanar travel.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret reported to Bolas that the New Phyrexians had not yet attained interplanar travel

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Many angels fight and die resisting Phyrexia on Mirrodin and several are captured and compleated.
timeline.quote: Several of these were captured and forcefully compleated .

citation.text: "Angel", section "Mirrodin/New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Atraxa saves hundreds of humans from corruption and attracts Elesh Norn's retribution.
timeline.quote: who had saved hundreds of humans from corruption before attracting Elesh Norn's retribution

citation.text: "Angel", section "Mirrodin/New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn gains influence, conquering Urabrask's and Sheoldred's domains.
timeline.quote: Slowly, Elesh Norn gained more influence, even in the furnace layers, effectively conquering Urabrask 's and Sheoldred 's domains.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Fall of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias writes the Gitaxian Standard of Purity with ideas from discussions with Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: Taking ideas from many lengthy discussions with Elesh Norn, the Gitaxian Standard of Purity gives Malcator and Uulbrek the basic rules and measures of compleation.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Lumengrid overseers alter Karn's throne so they can monitor information flowing to him, unknown to Karn and Elesh Norn's priests.
timeline.quote: The overseers of Lumengrid have altered the throne itself so that they can monitor the inflow of information to Karn.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn sought to induct Karn as the Father of Machines, intending to install a puppet.
timeline.quote: She sought to help induct Karn as the Father of Machines

citation.text: "Getting to Know the Praetors". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Atraxa is captured at the Phyrexian conquest of Mirrodin and compleated by Norn, marking Phyrexia's final victory over Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: Atraxa's creation marked the final victory of Phyrexia over Mirrodin.

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Rise of the praetors". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The resistance is slaughtered and Koth sacrifices himself to let a wounded Elspeth escape.
timeline.quote: a Phyrexian Obliterator grievously injured the trapped knight before she could leave

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Mirrodin Falls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn takes over Urabrask's and Sheoldred's domains and is crowned.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn took control over the domains of Urabask and Sheoldred

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Domination of New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The new Phyrexians split into five factions, each led by a praetor, and Elesh Norn's white-aligned faction subdues the rest and becomes Mother of Machines.
timeline.quote: managed to subdue the other factions and install her as Mother of Machines

citation.text: "Phyrexian", section "Lore". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn lays waste to Sheoldred's domain, and Sheoldred then serves Norn in the multiversal invasions.
timeline.quote: Ultimately, Elesh Norn laid waste to her domain.

citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "Mirran-Phyrexian War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn lays waste to Urabrask's domain; the Mirrans flee to mountain shelters and Urabrask's red Phyrexians dwell in the Furnace Layer.
timeline.quote: Inevitably, Elesh Norn laid waste to his domain

citation.text: "Urabrask", section "On New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The resistance focuses on destroying Elesh Norn, believing she dominated other praetors' domains.
timeline.quote: So we focused our energies on destroying her.

citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Ephara appears in Elesh Norn's vision defending Theros and blesses its champions with godfire.
timeline.quote: She blessed the champions of Theros with divine flame

citation.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Atraxa, a captured Mirran angel, is compleated by Elesh Norn and the other praetors except Urabrask.
timeline.quote: The praetor Elesh Norn honored the angel's tenacity with the blessed gift of Phyrexian compleation

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn declares that Phyrexia's magnificence must be brought to other worlds.
timeline.quote: If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them.

citation.text: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite (Iconic Masters, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A strike team infiltrates New Phyrexia and Vraska, Nahiri, Lukka, Jace and Nissa are compleated.
timeline.quote: Vraska , Nahiri , Lukka , Jace and Nissa are all compleated .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The bridge sends Vorinclex to Kaldheim to obtain Tyrite and brings him back to New Phyrexia, burning off his organic parts each way.
timeline.quote: The Planar Bridge was used to transport the praetor Vorinclex to the plane of Kaldheim to obtain a sample of Tyrite

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex is sent to Kaldheim through the Planar Bridge on Norn's orders; the process destroys his body and he rebuilds himself.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex was sent to Kaldheim through the Planar Bridge on Norn's orders.

citation.text: "Vorinclex", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias announces the first Phyrexianized planeswalker and Tezzeret asks whether Elesh Norn knows.
timeline.quote: Does Elesh Norn know you've succeeded in creating the first Phyrexianized planeswalker?"

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn challenges Jin-Gitaxias to find a way to turn planeswalkers into Phyrexians; with Tezzeret he goes to Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: the praetor Elesh Norn challenged Jin-Gitaxias to find a way to turn planeswalkers into Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Jin-Gitaxias", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Seeking a new body, Tezzeret allies with New Phyrexia while secretly backing Urabrask and alerting the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: he simultaneously supported the rebel praetor Urabrask and discreetly alerted the Gatewatch through trusted intermediaries

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Vivien he works for Elesh Norn, and Vivien draws her bow on him in hostility.
timeline.quote: The bowstring was at her cheek in a breath, her opposite arm outstretched.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Urabrask explains he serves no one and will not give Elesh Norn the Quiet Furnace, and says he will lead a challenge to her control.
timeline.quote: "Yes. I will lead a necessary challenge to Norn's control."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Urabrask asks Vivien to find Elspeth, a planeswalker whom Norn fears.
timeline.quote: "Norn fears her. That is all I know."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: In the modern day Elesh Norn sends Atraxa to command a second Phyrexian invasion of Capenna.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn sent her greatest creation, Atraxa, as the commander of this incursion.

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Capenna", section "The Second Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Norn addresses the Phyrexian faithful in the Fair Basilica's courtyard while holding a captive Mirran, to be flayed and altered as an example of the Machine Orthodoxy.
timeline.quote: "Soon, this wretched human will be released from the burden of fear.

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Norn pours her glistening oil over the Mirran, who convulses and sprouts fibrous roots through her body.
timeline.quote: a pulpy cord of organic material, a fibrous wooden root, sinuous and alien, burst from the human's belly.

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Norn slays the Mirran with a blade of her porcelain armor and tells the crowd she was too corrupt to save, hiding her own unease.
timeline.quote: "She was a vessel so corrupt, not even our glistening oil could save her.

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Norn returns to the courtyard and finds an organic weed sprouting through the flagstones, which turns out to be a human forearm.
timeline.quote: Instead, a human forearm dangled, disproportionately large, half-rotten

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: More body-part weeds grow all over the courtyard, and Norn begins to doubt that she herself might be the flaw.
timeline.quote: Was she somehow intrinsically corrupt?

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Norn realizes the world is a dream-like illusion and names the planeswalker Ashiok.
timeline.quote: Scowling, she whispered, "Ashiok."

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Ashiok appears, admits to creating the nightmare as art and testing whether a Phyrexian mind can be afraid.
timeline.quote: I was not certain Phyrexians would be suitable for my art.

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reveals a head of Elspeth Tirel in the garden, saying they first encountered her on Theros and sought her in the Underworld.
timeline.quote: "Her name is Elspeth Tirel."

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Norn rejects Ashiok, summoning dream Phyrexians from her own will and declaring that they are one.
timeline.quote: "We are one," Norn said.

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: The nightmare garden merges into creatures that attack, and Phyrexians and Norn cut them down.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians surged forward, slicing through the dream manifestations

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Ashiok shapes a nightmare Elspeth in the mirror of Norn's form, which frightens Norn before she slays it.
timeline.quote: she flung it into the nightmare version of Elspeth Tirel

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Ashiok flees, the nightmare dissolves and Norn is left shaken by the pity in the false Elspeth's eyes.
timeline.quote: She looked at Norn with such human pity

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Norn resolves to find Elspeth Tirel and rid the Multiverse of her.
timeline.quote: she would need to find the human, Elspeth Tirel, and rid the Multiverse of her.

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn arrives in a Phyrexian cavern and is welcomed by Elesh Norn, who calls him Father.
timeline.quote: Welcome, Father.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn shows the helpless Karn a small oil-beaded sapling and calls it the beginning of everything.
timeline.quote: It is the beginning of great things, Father.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians topple tributes to Serra in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians toppled tributes to Serra in favor of idols of Elesh Norn

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Second Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn is captured by the compleated Ajani and Sheoldred at the Battle of the Mana Rig and brought before Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: During the Battle of the Mana Rig , Karn was captured by the compleated Ajani and Sheoldred.

citation.text: "Karn", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vivien reveals that Urabrask opposes Elesh Norn, who has nearly unified New Phyrexia and plans to expand her dominion at once.
timeline.quote: That Elesh Norn, a rival praetor, has nearly unified New Phyrexia under her banner,

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: An angel blocks Tezzeret from leaving and orders him to carry the pieces of Karn to Elesh Norn for his reward.
timeline.quote: you will bring the pieces of Father to our Mother.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: In the Darksteel Eye, Tezzeret sees vast Phyrexian legions assembling but cannot view Urabrask's domain or Elesh Norn's sanctum.
timeline.quote: he discovered that two locations managed to defy the eye's intrusion.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reaches Elesh Norn at the heart of the plane, where she takes Karn's torso and welcomes him to the great work.
timeline.quote: We welcome you to our great work.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn tells Tezzeret he will be herald on Dominaria; he realizes she will not give him his body and resolves to wage war on her.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn had no intention of fulfilling her promise.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn speaks of Jhoira and is cut off by Elesh Norn; Tezzeret sees it as a good move on his part.
timeline.quote: Jhoira . . . Jhoira is my friend . . . my best friend.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn dismisses Tezzeret, who leaves angrily.
timeline.quote: With a growl, Tezzeret turned and walked away.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret oversees Karn's disassembly and reveals to him that he is not truly loyal to New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret returned to New Phyrexia and oversaw the disassembly of Karn

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Koth explains Elesh Norn ossifies her favorites and adds them to her Fair Basilica as the group passes a colossus.
timeline.quote: Turned to bone and added to her Fair Basilica.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn enters with Phyrexian warriors, Tamiyo, and Jace's risen corpse, welcoming the survivors to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Welcome, weary travelers, to Phyrexia,

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Compleated Nahiri and Nissa are revealed beside Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: Nahiri had clearly not survived her fall.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The survivors refuse to yield, and Elesh Norn begins the invasion.
timeline.quote: and the invasion began.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn summons Tezzeret and orders Rona's remains sent to Jin-Gitaxias.
timeline.quote: Send the other to Jin-Gitaxias for reconditioning.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret blames his failure on Rona and Sheoldred's treachery, and Norn accepts it.
timeline.quote: We were routed when our own troops turned on us.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn questions Tezzeret's love for her, while Tezzeret restrains his urge to kill her.
timeline.quote: One well-placed thrust of his sharpened arm could impale her head or take it right off.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Norn that the Planeswalkers' new leader is Elspeth Tirel, wielding a blade of white light, and Norn grows fearful.
timeline.quote: The leader's name is Elspeth Tirel.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret asks for his promised darksteel body and collapses, and Norn declares a promise is a promise.
